text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait plans measures to combat school violence after a 15-year-old shot and wounded his teacher.
- Kuwait Investment Co (KIC) to launch a mutual fund. The state Kuwait Investment Authority plans to launch a $82.5 million fund to be managed by KIC.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange share index rises 6.7 points to 2,204.1 in firmer trade on Saturday.
- Bomb scare at the state's Bayan Palace. No bombs were found after a thorough search.
- Jordan seeks lifting of Iraq sanctions. The United Nations imposed a strict embargo against Baghdad when Iraqi troops occupied Kuwait in 1990.
